role: CANON A.5 boundary enforcement: narrow read-only Layer 2→3 interface for object re-identification via multi-modal matching
detail: PersistenceCheckService implements the sole Layer 2→3 persistence query point, calling only find_nodes_by_embedding() on GraphPersistence to avoid coupling. compute_match_score() combines five scoring signals (embedding cosine similarity, spatial IoU, color histogram Jaccard, bbox size ratio, label raw match) with dynamic weights interpolated between two profiles based on confirmation_count threshold (5=new/spatial-dominant, 10+=known/embedding-dominant). Surprise detection flags when confirmation_count>=5 and embedding_distance exceeds surprise_threshold (Piaget R2). Ambiguous candidates (score >= ambiguity_threshold but < match_threshold) are reported for Layer 3 to handle POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_OF edges; this service does NOT create them per D-TS-01.
gotchas: CANON A.5 contract enforced: find_match() calls ONLY find_nodes_by_embedding() on persistence backend; any Layer 3 method addition requires CANON amendment. Returns None if observation lacks embedding (caller treats as cache miss). surprise_flag set only for confirmation_count>=5; embedding_distance=1.0-cosine_similarity. Cosine similarity clamped to [0.0, 1.0] to handle floating-point overshoot. Color scoring uses coarse 4x4x4 bin quantization (divide by 64), not full histogram. IoU and size scoring fail gracefully on missing/malformed node_bbox dicts.
